narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The growth is the two counts added together, one lakh eighty one thousand.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But growth cannot be bigger than the town itself today.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The slip is bigger than the later count, so it is struck out.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Growth is the later count take away the earlier count.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Never add the two counts for growth.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>A stepping stone gives a second way to check.
removed_beats.on_screen: the words later take away earlier appear; the words do not add appear; the words second way appear

old_misconception.wrong_move: A common slip adds the two counts together. Adding gives a number bigger than either count, but the growth is smaller than both.
